ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator schema drift before removing the legacy parser shim to identify all schema inconsistencies that are currently masked.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report documenting all discrepancies between translator output and expected step-id schema.

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Update dependency-graph fixtures to reflect the new schema so the plan contract can catch ordering regressions.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated test fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that validate the new step-id schema.

ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after the schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature enabled behind kill switch with canary-only coverage.

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook documenting rollout and rollback procedures for the dashboard summary.

dependency_notes.reason: Schema drift must be audited before fixtures can be correctly backfilled to reflect the new schema.
Dashboard summary consumes step-id schema and must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema.
Runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary deployment.

primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect or broken step ordering to users if enabled before schema is stable and fixtures are updated.
mitigations: Enable dashboard behind kill switch (RN-103) only after schema audit (RN-101) and fixture backfill (RN-102) are complete
Validate canary deployment before broader rollout
Ensure plan_contract.py tests pass with updated fixtures before enabling dashboard

assumption_ledger.note: The schema drift audit may reveal more extensive translator changes than anticipated; scope to be determined during RN-101.
Kill switch infrastructure for dashboard summary feature flag needs verification.
Canary environment availability and configuration for RN-103 validation needs confirmation.
